Which patients discharged from the hospital had no follow-up visit within 14 days? Definition: Inpatient discharges (TOB 011x/012x with discharge status 01 or 06, or ADT inpatient with disposition home or home health) 14 to 182 days before as_of, with no visit (completed office-class encounter (office, wellness or pediatric; virtual and telephone excluded), or billed CPT 99202-99215) on days 1-14 after discharge. Lab-draw, nurse-only, telephone, virtual and orders-only contacts do not count as follow-up.
